name: Aalborg University
about: Aalborg University has 17,195 full-time students across Aalborg, Esbjerg and Copenhagen, according to its October 2026 figures. Its problem-based learning combines lectures with projects on real problems, often with companies. Three English-taught bachelor's degrees are in engineering at Esbjerg; Economics and Business Administration is in Aalborg.

languageOfInstruction.note: AAU's current IB admissions guide lists four English-taught bachelor's degrees: three engineering programmes in Esbjerg and Economics and Business Administration in Aalborg. Other programmes require Danish A or the Danish language study test.

notes: AAU's current IB admissions guide lists four English-taught bachelor's degrees: three engineering programmes in Esbjerg and Economics and Business Administration in Aalborg. Other programmes require Danish A or the Danish language study test.

Apply through Optagelse.dk by 15 March at 12:00 noon CET and send the signed signature page to bacheloroptag@aau.dk before the deadline. These are AAU's currently published annual rules; a full 2027 admissions calendar is not yet published.

Give your IB coordinator AAU results-service code 000148. Other application documents are due 5 July at noon; AAU retrieves the later IB results online. Offers are communicated in UniStart by 28 July, with acceptance or rejection due 5 August under the current annual rules.

If you pay tuition, AAU says you cannot apply in the year you earn your IB because your documentation deadline is 1 May. Non-EU citizenship alone does not establish whether you pay: residence-based exemptions exist.

EU/EEA citizens pay no tuition or application fee. Other applicants normally pay EUR 150 to apply, unless exempt. Published tuition is for 2026: DKK 115,700 for two semesters of engineering or DKK 55,600 for business; 2027 rates are not yet published.
Applied Industrial Electronics becomes restricted in 2027. Its 2026 All admitted result does not guarantee a place in 2027; the 2027 quota split and capacity are not yet published.
Chemical Engineering and Biotechnology lists both 24 and 25 places for 2026 on the same page. Its 2027 capacity is not yet published.
Projects often involve groups of four or five, with individual assessment in group examinations. AAU says group work throughout the whole degree is not compulsory.
